name: Where Monkey
look: Three orangutans sit upright like TV presenters on red sofas in a bright morning news studio, around a round white table with a glass top, papers and a mug. Big windows behind them show a city skyline at sunrise.
use: The orangutans act as a TV panel talking in simple caveman-style phrases. A caption sits beside one of them as its line, like the well-known 'where banana', often to mock a blunt, simple-minded question or demand.
slots: line spoken by one of the orangutans
examples: Me opening the fridge at midnight
The team after the server goes down
